primary_method.join_key: ONS LSOA21 code from exact canonical point to official ONS LSOA intersection
primary_method.source_edition_rule: Use only the current corrected v2 IoD25 LSOA file reached from the official release page updated 17 November 2025; record download hash and edition evidence.
primary_method.universe_rule: Read the exact number of unique LSOA21 rows from the hashed IoD25 File 7; expected official universe is 33,755 LSOAs.
primary_method.direction: Crime rank 1 maps to ordinal position 0.0; crime rank 33,755 maps to ordinal position 100.0.
primary_method.official_decile_rule: Publish the official Crime Decile unchanged; do not recompute deciles.
primary_method.interpretation: Ordinal relative position in the IoD25 Crime Domain at LSOA level. It supports ordering only: a value twice as large does not mean twice as safe or half as deprived. It is not a current monthly crime rate, exact incident probability, title-boundary condition or personal safety guarantee.

police_api_method_guard.location_semantics: approximate and anonymised, not exact crime locations
police_api_method_guard.forbidden_calculation: Do not divide a one-mile point-query crime count by an LSOA population denominator.
police_api_method_guard.reason: The numerator geography and denominator geography are not aligned and nearby point-query results may overlap across parcels.
police_api_method_guard.allowed_current_role: Explicit-month response availability, response SHA256, category distribution and evidence-integrity cross-check only.
police_api_method_guard.future_rate_option: A separate exact LSOA polygon query may be evaluated only with polygon hash, explicit month, deduplication, disclosure/anonymisation caveat and matching LSOA population edition; it remains secondary and must not be blended into the ordinal IoD25 candidate without a separately reviewed method.

required_for_95_plus: canonical point source blob matches bb48164e7a0af78df875f30421a6a3068c43edb8
exact target parcel ID is unique
exactly one current-v2 IoD25 File 7 row for the LSOA21 code
IoD25 File 7 download hash and schema recorded
crime rank and official crime decile are non-null and in range
method version, ordinal interpretation and source editions are visible on the website
automatic_score_blockers: zero or multiple ONS LSOA matches
missing or duplicate IoD25 LSOA row
current corrected v2 source edition or hash missing
cardinal or proportional interpretation of rank differences
attempt to normalise one-mile point-query counts with LSOA population
served HTTP or DOM acceptance failure
